content.title: 空中群集｜近表面转向到稳定落地
content.summary: 始终跟住一个主体，近表面改变方向后拉宽重建地理，最后真实落地。

quick_start.input_format: 单一领衔主体＋空中群集＋近表面转向＋终点落地
quick_start.recommended_input: 阴天海上风机测试区，一台橙色主巡检无人机、三台深色辅助无人机、带黄色安全桅杆的甲板、橙边降落垫。
required_anchors: 最后接触面与余动可见
usage_steps: 把示例主体、场景和表层元素替换为原创概念。
让每个必需锚点和 Creative DNA 不可变条件都能在画面因果链中被看见。
选择 MiniMax H3 或 Seedance 2.0 模板，只填写已声明的可替换项。
生成前检查时长、事件顺序、镜头连续性、声音和反复制约束。
applicable_scope: 始终跟住一个主体，近表面改变方向后拉宽重建地理，最后真实落地。
能够保留全部必需锚点的原创 4–15 秒短片。
需要可复用因果视频结构的 MiniMax H3 或 Seedance 2.0 项目。
not_suitable_for: 要求复制来源人物、场景、道具、对白或镜头顺序的任务。
无法在目标时长内展示全部必需锚点的概念。
缺少紧凑因果链的长篇讲解或无关多地点叙事。

creative_dna.mechanism: Track one lead through a crowded airborne opening, one direction change visibly close to a fixed surface, a brief wide geography reset and a final weighted landing that resolves accumulated motion. The source touches a roof in the middle phase; the drone transfer stays airborne above a deck until the final pad landing.

invariants.rule: Keep one tracked lead through an opening airborne cluster and a direction change visibly close to a fixed surface; source contact and transferred near-surface flight need not have identical physics.
invariants.purpose: Audience can follow a protagonist despite high motion density.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without stable lead and terrain, the action reads as unrelated clips.

invariants.rule: Reopen geography after the near-surface direction-change phase before the final descent.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without the wider reset the final landing has no readable origin.

invariants.rule: Close on a physical braced landing with visible residual motion.
invariants.purpose: Provides a measurable payoff and end state.
invariants.ablation_failure: An airborne freeze or weightless disappearance leaves motion unresolved.

slots.name: lead
slots.constraint: One visually persistent adult performer or machine.

slots.name: ground_plane
slots.constraint: A physical surface for the mid-beat and final landing.

slots.name: secondary_movers
slots.constraint: Distinct from lead, no duplicate identity.

slots.name: camera_reset
slots.constraint: One wider view before final descent.

slots.name: landing_residue
slots.constraint: Small material movement that settles after contact.

anti_copy_exclusions: No source faces, dark martial costume, traditional rooftops, skyline combination, sparks or blows.
No unverified injury or lethal force.
No hovering final pose: land with contact and residual motion.

instantiations.concept: At a coastal wind-energy test range, one orange inspection drone is the tracked lead among several dark service drones. In one ten-second run it crosses above turbine support platforms, drops to skim over a marked deck, banks around a stationary safety mast, then the camera opens to show the full array and the lead descends onto its dedicated landing pad. Rotor wash moves only lightweight dust at the pad; all drones stay separate and no collisions occur.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Orange inspection drone, coastal wind array, deck skim, wide reset, marked landing pad.

instantiations.concept: At a bright indoor aerial-acrobatics arena, one adult performer in a teal safety harness passes through two suspended rings, lands briefly on a sprung mat to change direction, takes a second assisted swing as the camera widens to show rigging, then returns to a stable mat landing. All aerial movement has visible rig and safe mat contact.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Adult harness acrobat, indoor rings, sprung mat, wider rig reveal, safe final landing.

failure_modes.failure: Lead loses identity among secondary movers.
failure_modes.repair: Assign one consistent color/silhouette and track it through all beats.

failure_modes.failure: Near-surface phase has no readable relation to the surface.
failure_modes.repair: For a drone show a consistent low altitude above the deck; for an acrobat show actual mat contact.
Keep pad and contact in frame through dust settlement.

transfer_tests.concept: At a coastal wind-energy test range, one orange inspection drone is the tracked lead among several dark service drones. In one ten-second run it crosses above turbine support platforms, drops to skim over a marked deck, banks around a stationary safety mast, then the camera opens to show the full array and the lead descends onto its dedicated landing pad. Rotor wash moves only lightweight dust at the pad; all drones stay separate and no collisions occur.

At a bright indoor aerial-acrobatics arena, one adult performer in a teal safety harness passes through two suspended rings, lands briefly on a sprung mat to change direction, takes a second assisted swing as the camera widens to show rigging, then returns to a stable mat landing. All aerial movement has visible rig and safe mat contact.

review.method: Chinese interface editorial pass with canonical English Creative DNA preserved after translation service rate limit
